notes:
Added
- The first version of Kirinuki for Windows. It installs just for you, without administrator rights, and brings everything it needs with it, so there is nothing else to install.
- A setup guide for your first start: read and accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Notice, check your PC, and optionally import your team's settings. You can run it again at any time from Settings.
- A system check that looks at your Windows version, free disk space, memory, graphics card and driver, Microsoft Edge WebView2, Smart App Control, Controlled Folder Access, where your data is kept, your PC's clock, secure connections and Kirinuki's own files. Anything that needs attention comes with a plain explanation and a way to fix it.
- Automatic updates. Kirinuki checks for new versions on its own, downloads them in the background and installs them when you choose "Install now", waiting until it isn't busy. Every update is digitally signed, and Kirinuki refuses any update that isn't genuine.
- A choice between Stable updates (the default) and Preview updates, which bring new versions a little earlier.
- Required updates: if a version has a serious problem, Kirinuki tells you that an update is required and offers to install it.
- A "What's new" screen after each update, showing what changed.
- Repair, in Settings: it checks Kirinuki's own files and, if any are missing or damaged, downloads a fresh copy of the same version and restores them.
- Settings sharing between PCs: export your team settings (channel, hashtags, posting times, description template and category) to a file and import it on another PC. You see every change before it is applied, and passwords or sign-ins are never included.
